name: Elizabeth
overview: Elizabeth was a righteous woman, described in Luke 1 as the wife of Zacharias and a descendant of Aaron, who lived blamelessly according to God's commandments. Despite her advanced age and barrenness, her story highlights God's sovereign grace in fulfilling His promises, as seen through the miraculous conception of John the Baptist. Their faithful obedience and God's intervention set the stage for the coming of the Messiah.
